transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because… it’s about my husband’s sister. She’s been working things in the family business, trying to get control of the money and push me out of decisions. People keep acting like it’s nothing, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on over a year.
Do you think your husband's sister is actually plotting against you?

Yes. I mean… I don’t like saying it like that, but yes. She’s been working things in the family business so she can get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. People try to make it sound harmless, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been more than a year.
Do you think your husband's sister is acting against you in a way that most people would find hard to believe or unusual?

I guess some people might think it sounds unusual, yes. But to me it’s not hard to see. She’s been working things in that family business to get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. People try to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve seen.
Do you think your husband's sister's actions are targeted specifically at you?

Yes… I do. It feels like it’s aimed at me, specifically. She’s trying to get control of the money side of the family business and push me out of the decisions. I know people keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you ever have times where you don't think your husband's sister is plotting against you?
Not really. I mean, people tell me to let it go, or they try to smooth it over, but… no. I know what I’ve been seeing with the business and the money decisions. It’s been going on too long.
Do you ever doubt that your husband's sister is plotting against you?

No… not really. I mean, people keep saying I’m taking it wrong, but I know what I’ve been seeing. She’s been working things with the family business and the money for over a year now, trying to push me out.
Do you think it's possible that you might be mistaken about your husband's sister plotting against you?

No… I don’t think so. I know what I’ve been seeing. She’s been working the family business side of things, trying to get control of the money and push me out of decisions. People can smooth it over all they want, but it’s been more than a year.
Has there ever been a time when you didn't think your husband's sister was plotting against you?
No. Not since I started seeing what she was doing with the family business and the money. People try to make it sound like nothing, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you often find yourself wondering if other people are out to get you?
Not other people, no… it’s really about my husband’s sister. She’s been working things with the family business and the money, trying to push me out of decisions. I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you often feel that other people besides your husband's sister might be hiding something from you?

Not really other people… I mean, folks smooth things over sometimes, but it’s mainly her. My husband’s sister. She’s been working the family business and the money, trying to push me out of decisions. I’ve seen enough.
Has your belief that your husband's sister is plotting against you ever changed or wavered over the past year?
No… it hasn’t really wavered. People keep trying to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing with her and the family business, the money. It’s been that way more than a year.
Do you have any other beliefs that you're completely sure of, but others around you don't understand or agree with?

No… not other things. It’s just this with my husband’s sister. The family business, the money… she’s been trying to get control and push me out of decisions. People don’t want to see it, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Do you often suspect that there are other things going on that people are not telling you?

I don’t go around suspecting everything, no. It’s… mostly this one thing with my husband’s sister and the family business. The money, the decisions. People try to make it sound like nothing, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It’s been going on a long time.
Do you think people in general are out to harm you or take advantage of you?

No… not people in general. I don’t think everybody’s out to get me. It’s really his sister. She’s been working things in the family business, trying to get control of the money and keep me out of decisions. People can say what they want, but I know what I’ve been seeing.
Has your belief that your husband's sister is plotting against you ever changed, even for a short period of time?
No… not really. People have tried to smooth it over or tell me I’m reading it wrong, but I haven’t changed my mind. I know what I’ve been seeing, and it’s been going on more than a year.
Do you often feel like you're in danger when you're alone or with people you don't know well?
Not really, no. I don’t think about danger like that when I’m alone or around strangers. It’s not… that kind of thing.
Have you ever had a period of time where you didn't think about your husband's sister plotting against you?
No. I mean… it’s been there. I came in because of what she’s doing with the family business and the money. People try to make it sound like nothing, but I’ve been seeing it for over a year.
Do you think there are other people who might be plotting against you besides your husband's sister?

No… not really other people. It’s mostly her. My husband’s sister, with the family business and the money… trying to push me out of things. I know what I’ve seen, even if people try to make it sound like nothing.
Do you think your belief about your husband's sister would change if you found out she wasn't actually plotting against you?

I don’t think it would change, no. I mean… I came here because of what she’s been doing with the family business and the money. People can try to smooth it over, but I know what I’ve been seeing for more than a year.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient's persistent and unshakeable belief that their husband's sister is plotting against them, despite others' attempts to reassure them and the lack of clear evidence, suggests a delusional disorder.
